name: aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae
statement: Measure α} {f : ι → α → β} {g : α → β} (u : Filter ι) [hu : NeBot u] [IsCountablyGenerated u] (hf : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (f n) μ) (h_tendsto : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) u (𝓝 (g x))) : AEMeasurable g μ

name: aemeasurable_of_unif_approx
statement: Measure α} {g : α → β} (hf : ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ f : α → β, AEMeasurable f μ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, dist (f x) (g x) ≤ ε) : AEMeasurable g μ

have_tree.type: ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ n, dist (f n x) (g x) ≤ u n

name: measurable_limit_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae
statement: Measure α} {f : ι → α → β} {L : Filter ι} [L.IsCountablyGenerated] (hf : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (f n) μ) (h_ae_tendsto : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ l : β, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) L (𝓝 l)) : ∃ f_lim : α → β, Measurable f_lim ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) L (𝓝 (f_lim x))
